title: Repair ancestry, background, equipment-grant, and proficiency projections
description:
Repair known source-fidelity defects in ancestry traits, background/equipment grants,
language/proficiency grants, material constraints, and represented variants. Use typed
data where source structure is stable or a real discovery/state/capability consumer needs
it; do not require every ancestry mechanic to become a deterministic procedure.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known ancestry/background/equipment/proficiency findings are repaired against source evidence.
- Structured choices and grants preserve source alternatives, quantities, currency, and ownership.
- Typed identities are stable where referenced by runtime consumers.
- Pack data consumed by a capability in force is source-faithful; that capability's contract, execution, and state evidence belong to the capability lane (eshyra-o9bd.19.5 / eshyra-olc5).
- Typed projection coverage is not treated as whole-record deterministic support.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
*** PACK/ENGINE PAIRING (2026-07-25) ***
Pack projection and reference-engine implementation are CO-DESIGNED. Do not
split them into two isolated efforts that meet only at the end.

This bead pairs with: engine:F1, F2, F5, F8, F10.

Coordinate decomposition and conformance scenarios with those epics under
eshyra-olc5. The reference engine is the executable VALIDATOR of this bead's
modeling contract, not a downstream consumer waiting for finished data: a
representation that cannot drive execution is not done, however complete it
looks in isolation. Expect this bead's schema and projectors to be revised
together with the engine as conformance tests expose contract gaps.

*** engine:F* IS A QUALIFIED PREFIX. engine:F1..F10 are the pack's
executionReadiness engineHooks families — NOT the CLOSED epic eshyra-2n1t's
different F1-F10, and NOT the fable:F1..F8 audit findings.
